NONE: › used to mean that any of several different possible actions will produce the same result
（無論如何做）結果都一樣

example: It doesn't matter whether you do it first or last - it all amounts to the same thing.
你最先做還是最後做這件事都無所謂——結果都一樣。

NONE: › said when you do not understand a situation or someone's behaviour
我不理解，我不明白

example: It beats me how she got the job.
我不明白她是怎樣得到這份工作的。
What beats me is why she stays with him.
我不理解她為甚麼跟他在一起。

NONE: › used to say that an unpleasant or painful situation, or an unwanted duty cannot be avoided and must be accepted
不可避免，別無選擇

example: I really didn't want to go away this weekend but, oh well, it can't be helped.
這週末我真的不想離家外出，可是，唉，不出去又不行。

NONE: › it is useful or helpful to do or have something
做…不會有甚麼壞處，做…是明智的

example: It never hurts to check the flight departure time before you leave for the airport.
在出發到機場前查看一下航班時間是明智的。
It doesn't hurt to have money when you want to run for office.
當你想競選公職的時候，有錢不是件壞事。

NONE: › used to say that you are not surprised by something unpleasant that has happened
那是意料之中的事，一點都不奇怪

example: "Dad, Sadie spilled her milk all over the floor." "It figures."
「爸爸，薩迪把她的牛奶全灑在地板上。」「我一點也不意外。」

NONE: B2 used to mean that something is obvious
不言而喻，不證自明，不用說

example: Of course, it goes without saying that you'll be paid for the extra hours you work.
當然，不用說，你加班是有報酬的。

NONE: › used to tell someone not to worry about, or place special value on, what you are doing or have done
別擔心；沒甚麼要緊的

example: "You seem very upset." "No, no, it's nothing - I'm OK."
「你看上去很不安。」「不，不，沒甚麼，我很好。」
"It was so nice of you to look after the baby all day." "Oh, it was nothing, I enjoyed it."
「謝謝你一整天照顧孩子。」「哦，沒甚麼，我很樂意效勞。」

NONE: › used for saying that it is still possible for a situation to change
某情形仍有機會改變
› used to say that something makes you very upset or angry
這件事氣死我了
› said when one bad thing happens, followed by a lot of other bad things that make a bad situation worse
不雨則已，一雨傾盆；禍不單行
› it is not yet certain
尚不確定；說不准

example: It remains to be seen who will win.
誰會贏現在尚不能確定。

NONE: › used to show how much of a particular quality someone or something has
充分說明，很能說明

example: It says a lot for her determination that she practises her cello so often.
她如此頻繁地練習大提琴，可見得她的確下定了決心。

NONE: C2 said when something is obvious or clear from the facts
不言而喻，顯而易見

example: If 20 percent of the earth's population has 80 percent of its resources, then it stands to reason that 80 percent of the population has only 20 percent of the resources.
如果地球上20%的人口佔有了80%的資源，那麽不言而喻地，80%的人口只擁有20%的資源。

NONE: › used to mean that one dishonest person can guess what another dishonest person might do
以賊捕賊；以毒攻毒。
› said to emphasize that people have different characters, opinions, and abilities, and that you should accept this
世界之大，無奇不有；一樣米養百樣人
› said when you want to emphasize that both people involved in a difficult situation must accept the blame, or that an activity needs two people who are willing to take part for it to happen
兩個人才跳得成探戈；雙方都有責任；一個巴掌拍不響

example: She may want to argue, but it takes two to tango and I won't stoop to her level.
她可能想要爭吵，可那也得我願意，我可不想跟她一般見識。

NONE: › something that you say when you think someone should do something because they do not often do it
做…不會有甚麼壞處，不妨做…

example: It wouldn't hurt you to do the ironing for once.
試熨一次衣服不會對你有甚麼害處。

NONE: › short form of it would
（it would的縮略形式）
› short form of it had
（it had的縮略形式）

example: It'd be better if we finished it today.
如果我們今天完成就好了。
I found the radio - it'd been left in the shed all weekend.
收音機我找到了——整個週末都落在車棚裡了。

NONE: › short form of it will
（it will的縮略形式）

example: It'll be hard to find someone to help.
很難找到人幫忙。

NONE: › UK something that you say that means something will end badly and the people involved will be upset
悲劇告終，不會有好結局

example: She only met him in May and they were married by July. It'll end in tears, you'll see.
她五月才認識他，然後他們七月就結婚了。這不會有好結果的，你等著瞧吧。

NONE: › it will be very expensive
要花很多錢；會很貴

example: It'll cost you to have your roof repaired.
修理屋頂要花很多錢。

NONE: › something that you say when you think a situation is wrong
可恥；不像話

example: It's a crying shame that she's paid so little for what she does.
給她那麽點工資真是太不應該了。

NONE: › used to say that a particular time is a good time to meet
（會面時間）很合適，沒問題，就這樣定了

example: "I can't make it at seven o'clock. How about 9.30?" "Sure, it's a date."
「我7點鐘不行，9點半怎麼樣？」「當然可以，沒問題。」

NONE: › something you say when someone has caught you doing something wrong and you agree that you were wrong
（當場被抓獲時承認錯誤）抓得對，抓得沒錯
› said when someone has told you something that is strange or surprising
大千世界，無奇不有。
› something that you say when someone has asked you about something that has happened and you do not want to explain it to them because it would take too long
說來話長（用於別人向你詢問某事時，表示你不想解釋，因為要花很長時間）

example: "So why was Carlo knocking on your door at midnight?" "It's a long story."
「那為甚麼卡羅在午夜時分去敲你的房門呢？」「那可就說來話長了。」

NONE: › a polite way of replying to someone who has thanked you
不客氣

example: "It was so kind of you to give us a lift." "Don't mention it - it was a pleasure."
「你真是太好了，讓我們搭便車。」「這沒甚麼，不用客氣。」

NONE: › said to show your surprise that people or events in different places are connected
這世界真小；真有這等巧事；無巧不成書

example: You know my old science teacher! Well, it's a small world, isn't it?
原來你認識我以前的理科老師！嘿，這真是太巧了，不是嗎？

NONE: › it is surprising
真奇怪；真令人驚訝

example: It's a wonder (that) he ever reached Paris, because he set off with only £5 in his pocket.
令人驚訝的是他竟然到了巴黎，因為他出發時口袋裡只有五英鎊。

NONE: › a phrase used in film making to tell actors and crew that filming of a particular scene, film, etc. has finished
完成，停機！（拍攝電影時，告知演員及工作人員某場景拍攝工作完成）
› a way of saying that you do not understand something that is said or written
我全然不懂；我一竅不通；對我來說是天書
› said to show that even a very bad situation must have some good results
天下無絕對的壞事。
› said when you think it is too soon to make a judgment about the likely result of something because a lot might still happen or change
言之過早；爲時尚早；來日方長

example: Our progress has been fairly slow so far, but it's early days.
到目前為止我們的進度很緩慢，但來日方長。

NONE: › something that you say that means that everyone in a particular situation is trying to do what is best for themselves and no one is trying to help anyone else
人不為己，天誅地滅（指在某種特定場合，每個人都會盡力維護自己的利益，而不會幫助他人）

example: It might be a civilized place to shop at other times, but come the January sales, it's every man for himself.
人們在購物時通常都能保持風度，但一月大減價則除外，這個時候，人不為己，天誅地滅。

NONE: › said about an event or situation that you cannot explain, or do not like but cannot change
（表示無法解釋或不喜歡，但不能改變的事）這是難免的事。
› something that you say in order to tell someone that you cannot do what they want you to do because you would lose your job
工作不允許；（做了某事）意味著要被解僱
› said to emphasize that it is not useful feeling sorry about something that has already happened
牛奶潑了，哭也無益；已成定局的事後悔也無用

example: It's no use crying over spilled milk - he's spent all the money, and there's nothing you can do about it.
事已至此，傷心也沒用——他把錢都花光了，對此你也毫無辦法。

NONE: › humorous used to say that you do not think that something is very difficult to do or to understand
這不是給大腦做手術（用來表示說話者認為…做起來並不困難或難以理解）

example: Just keep calm and do it. It's not brain surgery.
保持鎮靜，就這麼做就行了，這又不是大腦手術。
See also
rocket science

NONE: › used to say that you do not think that something is very difficult to do or to understand
並不太難；並非特別複雜

example: Come on, it's only a crossword, it's not rocket science.
來吧，不就是個填字遊戲嘛，並不是那麼難。
Drugs equals crime. It doesn't take a rocket scientist to figure that one out.
毒品等於犯罪。這個道理十分顯淺，不是火箭科學家才懂的。
See also
brain surgery

NONE: › said when you must do something immediately, especially because you will not get another chance
機不可失；勿失良機
› something that you say when it is raining heavily
滂沱大雨，傾盆大雨
C1 used to say that you are confident about what you are going to say
（用來表示對將要說的話很有信心）

example: I think it's safe to say that the crisis is now over.
我很肯定危機已經過去了。

NONE: › a polite answer to someone who thanks you, usually when you feel you should do more to help
盡一點微薄之力而已

example: "Thanks for cleaning up" "It's the least I can do, seeing as I'm staying here rent-free."
「謝謝你替我打掃乾淨。」「我住在這裡你連房租都沒收，我做這點事算不了甚麽。」

NONE: C1 said when talking about a bad situation that has happened many times before
一直都是這樣，又是老樣子（表示糟糕的情況以前多次出現）

example: It's the same old story - the rich get richer and the poor get poorer.
還是老樣子——富人愈富，窮人愈窮。

NONE: › used to mean that people in important positions have a lot of advantages and get a lot of good things
處在高位就是不一樣（表示他們可以享受很多優厚待遇）

example: "The CEO always flies first class." "It's tough at the top, isn't it?"
「執行長乘飛機總是坐頭等艙。」「職位高待遇就是不一樣，對吧？」

NONE: › used to tell someone that they are responsible for their own problems
是你自己的責任，都怪你自己

example: It's your own lookout if you're not properly insured.
沒有適當投保是你自己的責任。

NONE: › said when things are continuing as they always do, despite a difficult situation
（儘管情況困難）一切照常
B2 it is a good thing
幸虧，幸好

example: It's beginning to rain - it's just as well that we brought our umbrellas.
開始下雨了——還好我們帶了雨傘。

NONE: › said when something bad happens to you that has happened to you many times before
（表示經常遇到類似的倒楣事）我就是這個命

example: Honestly, it's the story of my life - I meet a totally gorgeous bloke and he's leaving for Australia the next day!
老實說，我就是這個命——我碰上一個非常喜歡的男人，但他第二天就要去澳大利亞！
